---
title: "Hansard"
---

Hansard data

```{r}
#| eval: false

install.packages(c("jsonlite", "tidyverse", "tidytext")
```

https://hansard.parliament.uk/

```{r}
#| eval: false

library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(tidytext)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

data_dir <- file.path("data", "hansard")
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

debate_id <- "A91DF2A1-6231-4A38-AF17-56B742D06E95"
debate_url <- paste0(
  "https://hansard-api.parliament.uk/debates/debate/", debate_id, ".json"
)
debate <- fromJSON(debate_url)
debate_date <- substr(debate$Overview$Date, 1, 10)
items <- debate$Items
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

transcript <- items |>
  filter(ItemType == "Contribution", !is.na(MemberId)) |>
  select(
    sequence = OrderInSection,
    contribution_id = ExternalId,
    member_id = MemberId,
    speaker = AttributedTo,
    text = Value
  )
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

transcript <- transcript |> mutate(date = debate_date)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

for (i in seq_len(nrow(transcript))) {
  text_html <- paste0("<body>", transcript$text[i], "</body>")
  parsed_html <- read_html(text_html)
  transcript$text[i] <- html_text(parsed_html)
}
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

member_ids <- unique(transcript$member_id)
contributors <- data.frame()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

for (id in member_ids) {
  member_url <- paste0(
    "https://members-api.parliament.uk/api/Members/", id,
    "?detailsForDate=", debate_date
  )
  member_response <- fromJSON(member_url)
  member <- member_response$value

  contributor <- data.frame(
    member_id = member$id,
    name = member$nameDisplayAs,
    party = member$latestParty$name,
    constituency = member$latestHouseMembership$membershipFrom,
    gender = member$gender
  )
  contributors <- bind_rows(contributors, contributor)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

write.csv(transcript, file.path(data_dir, "transcript.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
write.csv(contributors, file.path(data_dir, "contributors.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

text_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "transcript.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

speaker_labels <- items$AttributedTo
speaker_labels[is.na(speaker_labels)] <- ""
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

formatted_text <- gsub("\r\n|\r|\n", "<br>", items$Value)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

html_entries <- paste0("<div><b>", speaker_labels, "</b><br>", formatted_text, "</div>")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

writeLines(c(
  "<!doctype html><meta charset='utf-8'>",
  paste0("<h1>", debate$Overview$Title, "</h1>"),
  paste0("<p>", debate_date, " | ", debate$Overview$House, "</p>"),
  html_entries
), file.path(data_dir, "transcript.html"), useBytes = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

text_data <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "transcript.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

word_data <- text_data |> unnest_tokens(word, text)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

word_totals <- word_data |> count(member_id, name = "words")
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

speaker_summary <- text_data |>
  count(member_id, name = "contributions") |>
  left_join(word_totals, by = "member_id") |>
  left_join(contributors, by = "member_id") |>
  arrange(desc(words))
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

print(speaker_summary)
write.csv(speaker_summary, file.path(data_dir, "speaker_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
